model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" values across different language families for six model variants. The horizontal axis is labeled "family" and contains nine categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, arranged from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 0 to 30, with tick marks at 0, 10, 20, and 30. Each language family group contains six bars corresponding to six model variants as indicated in the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink/salmon), and XLM-B₂ (red). Each bar also displays error bars (black whiskers) indicating variability. For IE-Baltic, all six bars are relatively short, ranging from approximately 1 to 5. For IE-Germanic, the bars range from near 0 (mBERT-R₂) to approximately 15 (XLM-B₂), with mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ both near 10. IE-Indic shows the tallest bars overall, with mBERT-B₂ reaching approximately 24, XLM-B₂ approximately 21, mBERT-R₂ approximately 21, and XLM-R₂ approximately 18, while mBERT-L₂ is near 1 and XLM-L₂ near 5. IE-Romance bars range from near 0 to approximately 13, with the B₂ variants being tallest. IE-Slavic shows bars ranging from approximately 1 to 17, with XLM-B₂ being the tallest. IE-other has bars ranging from approximately 0 to 8. Isolate shows very small bars, all near 0. Semitic displays mBERT-L₂ at approximately 11 and XLM-L₂ near 5, with the R₂ variants slightly negative and the B₂ variants near 0, accompanied by notably large error bars. Uralic shows mostly near-zero values except for XLM-B₂ at approximately 19, also with large error bars. The bars within each group are arranged in the consistent order matching the legend, and no bars appear to be specifically emphasized beyond their color coding.
